customSections.label: 2026–27 Calendar Revision Note
customSections.content: CUSD revised its 2026–27 school calendar on April 22, 2026. The earlier Board-approved version dated February 21, 2024 listed the high school Back-to-School Night window as September 1–3 and the elementary window as September 8–10. The revised April 22 calendar reverses those two windows: elementary is September 1–3 and high school is September 8–10. This page follows the revised calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CUSD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Capistrano Unified starts the 2026–27 school year on Tuesday, August 18, 2026. It is a minimum day for elementary and middle school students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CUSD Spring Recess in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs Monday, April 5, through Friday, April 9, 2027. School resumes Monday, April 12.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CUSD Winter Recess, and when does school resume?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. School resumes Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CUSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, June 3, 2027. CUSD lists it as a minimum day for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: Which CUSD dates are minimum days or pupil-free days?
calendarFaqs.a: November 2 and December 18 are K–12 pupil-free days. Minimum-day schedules include August 18 for elementary and middle school students, elementary conference windows November 3–6 and March 1–4, high school final-exam windows December 15–17 and June 1–3, and June 3 for all students. Check the assigned school for exact dismissal times.
Yes. CUSD identifies the current 2026–27 calendar as revised and Board approved April 22, 2026. This page follows that revised calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I get the official CUSD 2026–27 PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF link in Downloads. The source is the revised CUSD calendar approved April 22, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I add the CUSD calendar to Google Calendar or Apple Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. MySchoolDates provides a one-time ICS file for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Outlook. It does not sync with later district revisions, so confirm changes with CUSD.

sourceReviewDetails: CUSD's calendars page identifies the current 2026–27 calendar as revised and Board approved April 22, 2026.
The revised calendar lists November 2 and December 18 as K–12 pupil-free days and uses “Minimum Day” for shortened student schedules.
The elementary Back-to-School Night window is September 1–3, and the high school window is September 8–10 in the revised calendar.
School-level dismissal times, Back-to-School Night dates, graduation details, and later changes should be confirmed with CUSD or the assigned school.
